transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the vendor agreement for the AI platform we're planning to use for customer-support chats and call transcripts starting next quarter. I've reviewed the draft, and there are several issues I need each of you to weigh in on before I can give final approval. The draft permits the vendor to use our submitted content to improve its services, provides for deletion within 30 days after termination, and doesn't specify a data-residency location. It also includes their standard liability and insurance language and gives us no express audit right. Per our contract-approval routine, I need privacy, insurance, and customer-contracts counsel to report any required changes before I can approve this. Let's go through it systematically.
